Open with a high but supportable class fund, plus fees paid separately, while protecting the class from claims-rate leakage and fee reversion.

declaration.negotiation_history_statement: The settlement was reached through confidential mediation. Consistent with the confidentiality of those proceedings, this statement does not disclose mediation communications or the parties’ negotiating positions. The parties agreed to a $30 million class fund, automatic distribution to identified class members, and a separate $4 million fee-and-expense request subject to court approval. Brightline will not oppose the fee request, and any amount not approved will be added to the class fund.
